newsitem.title: USA: Rhone-Poulenc offers new enuresis nasal drug.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc offers new enuresis nasal drug.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc said Monday the new room-temperature formulation of desmopressin acetate (DDAVP) nasal spray is now available in the United States.
The spray is used for the treatment of primary nocturnal enuresis, commonly known as bed-wetting, which affects between five million and seven million children in the United States, the company said.
DDAVP reduces urine production in children who wet the bed by supplementing their natural antidiuretic hormone.

The company said room-temperature DDAVP may offer convenience to those patients who are required to administer the medication in environments outside the home because it does not require refrigeration.
